tasks.short: Arrange training around shifts, available rooms, equipment and instructors across our three sites.

today.trigger: A course request, onboarding cohort or approaching certificate expiry requires a class. The workflow below is inferred.
steps: Check Studytube for learners, course requirements and certificate deadlines.
Ask site planners for shift availability and minimum staffing requirements.
Check Outlook calendars and contact instructors about rooms, equipment and dates.
Book the session, enrol learners in Studytube and send joining instructions.
Chase confirmations and rearrange bookings when shifts or instructors change.
systems: Site shift schedules; source to confirm
Staffing agency portals where flex workers need training
drudgery: Comparing calendars and shift lists by hand
Copying booking details between Outlook and Studytube
Rebooking the same learners after changes
today.time_sinks: Finding a slot that preserves warehouse coverage takes repeated exchanges. The stated baseline is 69 hours per FTE annually; its breakdown needs measurement.

lenses.faster: A rules engine compares shift availability, certificate deadlines and resource calendars together. Manual calendar comparison and repeated copying disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new approved training request or approaching expiry starts scheduling automatically. Routine sessions are booked within agreed staffing, cost and timetable limits; conflicts go to L&D.
lenses.ambitious: Plan certificate renewals and week-one onboarding capacity across all three sites before demand becomes urgent. Include seasonal flex workers where agency responsibilities and data access are agreed.
lenses.joy: Remove availability chasing and repetitive rebooking. Keep the conversations that help supervisors release people for useful training.
lenses.options: Compare five feasible schedules by coverage, travel, instructor cost and deadline risk. Show the consequence of postponing a class or adding an evening session.
lenses.altitude: Own the scheduling rules, service levels and exception review. Improve the system using missed sessions, late renewals and lost production hours.
reach: HR Administrator: coordinate onboarding training appointments
Site planner: forecast training-related staffing gaps
Agency coordinator: arrange agreed training slots for flex workers

tasks.human_edge: Negotiate release from busy shifts and resolve conflicts between operational pressure, learning needs and certificate deadlines.
tasks.pattern_why: Dates, capacity, qualifications and staffing limits can be expressed as rules and checked. AI coding can help build the scheduler; routine scheduling does not need a language model.

in_practice.trigger: An approved course request, new starter cohort, certificate renewal threshold or confirmed schedule change.
steps: Read minimum learner and course data from Studytube and approved shift exports; check freshness.
Read instructor, room and equipment availability and calculate feasible slots under approved rules.
Recheck availability, reserve resources and create enrolments through supported interfaces; prevent duplicate bookings.
Send approved instructions through existing employee and agency channels.
Route capacity conflicts, extra costs and failed updates to L&D; reconcile bookings after changes.
in_practice.human_gate: L&D and operations approve the rules initially. L&D approves exceptions involving overtime, extra spend, missed deadlines or staffing below agreed limits.
systems: Studytube supported API or import, subject to verification
Microsoft Graph and Outlook resource calendars
data_needed: Learner identifier, site, shift availability and contact channel
Course duration, prerequisites and certificate expiry dates
Instructor qualifications and availability
Room and equipment capacity and availability
Minimum staffing, travel allowances and applicable CAO working-time rules
Agency training responsibilities and approved participant lists
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint booking log containing request ID, input timestamps, rule version, reservations, enrolment results, exceptions and overrides.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Graph can retrieve free/busy availability for users, rooms and equipment; this supports the calendar portion of the scheduler.
A rules engine could combine calendar availability with shift coverage and training requirements. The complete Noordhaven integration is proposed.
The 70% reduction in human effort and 2.5-times end-to-end speedup are pilot hypotheses; instructor responses and capacity constraints remain.

risks: Outlook availability does not establish availability for warehouse workers; stale shift data could produce unsafe staffing gaps.
Studytube enrolment interfaces and external instructor calendars may require manual handling.
Concurrent bookings can cause conflicts unless reservations are rechecked and partial failures reconciled.
Training time, overtime and rest periods need rules checked against the applicable CAO and company arrangements.
Use minimum personal data under AVG/GDPR. Assess OR consent if the rollout changes collective training, working-time or employee-data arrangements.
research_questions: Can Studytube create, change and cancel enrolments through a supported interface in Noordhaven's subscription?
Where are authoritative shift schedules held, and how quickly do they reflect swaps and agency changes?
What proportion of recent bookings fits rules without negotiation over coverage, travel or extra costs?
In a one-site pilot, does the scheduler reduce effort and booking lead time without increasing conflicts or missed renewals?

tasks.short: Track training spend and explain our budget, overspend and proposed investments to HR and Finance.

today.trigger: Monthly reporting, a budget review or a request to justify training expenditure. The workflow below is inferred.
steps: Collect training invoices and postings from AFAS and course records from Studytube.
Update Excel with approved budgets, outstanding orders and expected course costs.
Match costs to courses, sites and cost centres; investigate missing or duplicate items.
Calculate actual spend, commitments and forecast against budget.
Write the explanation and discuss proposed spending with HR and Finance.
systems: AFAS Profit general ledger and accounts payable
today.time_sinks: Reconciling booked invoices with future commitments and explaining inconsistent coding. The stated baseline is 65.9 hours per FTE annually.

lenses.faster: Reuse the nightly AFAS extract and a maintained course-to-cost mapping to produce reconciled tables. AI drafts commentary from checked figures and confirmed explanations.
lenses.autonomous: After a successful refresh, rules update actuals, commitments and forecast and flag variances. The monthly report is prepared automatically for L&D approval.
lenses.ambitious: Track cost per completed onboarding pathway and cost per employee reaching agreed proficiency. Compare these with 90-day retention without claiming training caused the difference.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet rebuilding and repeated invoice matching. Spend time deciding which training deserves funding and discussing trade-offs with managers.
lenses.options: Produce minimum-compliance, current-plan and expansion budgets. Show the effect of cohort size, cancellations, internal trainers and shift backfill.
lenses.altitude: Own the training investment model and evidence standards. Improve coding and forecast accuracy instead of assembling each report.
reach: Controller: prepare reconciled training cost-centre variance analysis
FP&A Analyst: maintain training demand and spend scenarios
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: define learning cost and outcome measures

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an expenditure serves operational needs and explain trade-offs that the numbers alone cannot settle.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software should reconcile and calculate financial figures; an llm_step can draft commentary from verified inputs. The report and investment justification need human approval because unexplained variances and funding choices require judgment.

in_practice.trigger: Successful nightly data refresh for monitoring, and the agreed monthly reporting date for the approval pack.
steps: Load the AFAS extract, approved budget and Studytube exports with source timestamps.
Apply approved mappings and reconcile totals; distinguish actuals, accruals, commitments and forecast to avoid double counting.
Calculate variances and scenarios using versioned formulas; block final reporting when reconciliation fails.
Draft commentary with links to figures and confirmed causes, marking unexplained changes as questions.
Obtain L&D approval and Controller validation of accounting exceptions, then save the approved report.
in_practice.human_gate: L&D approves every monthly report and expenditure justification. The Controller approves accounting treatment and material reconciliation exceptions; existing spending authority still applies.
systems: AFAS Profit extract or configured GetConnectors
Proposed approved language-model service for commentary
data_needed: Training ledger postings, invoice references and cost centres
Approved budget versions and purchase commitments
Course identifiers, enrolments, completions and cancellations
Finance-approved treatment of VAT, accruals and internal training costs
Approved rates for learner time, trainers and shift backfill
Confirmed variance explanations and reporting thresholds
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint reporting folder with source snapshot IDs, reconciliation results, mapping and formula versions, draft commentary and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors retrieve configured records and fields from Profit, providing a supported route for scoped reporting data.
Power BI supports scheduled data refresh; Noordhaven still needs checks for successful refresh and source freshness.
Grounded commentary drafting is plausible, but automatic financial justification and the full cross-system workflow are unverified.
The 65% human-effort saving and 2.2-times end-to-end speedup assume stable coding and accessible commitments; these are estimates.

risks: Late invoices, missing commitments or duplicate accruals can make the forecast misleading even when ledger totals reconcile.
Generated commentary may invent a cause for overspend; require confirmed causes or explicitly unresolved questions.
Course completion and retention associations do not establish return on investment or causation.
Employee-level costs and pay rates require restricted access under AVG/GDPR; use aggregate reporting where possible.
Report approval must not become automatic approval of expenditure or changes to financial postings.
research_questions: What share of training spend can be reliably matched to a course and cost centre using current identifiers?
Are approved commitments and cancellation charges available before invoices arrive?
Can the Controller reconcile a prototype to two closed months using agreed accounting definitions?
Does a pilot reduce preparation time while preserving correction rates and forecast accuracy?

tasks.short: Build fair development routes from warehouse and office roles into supervisory and management positions.

today.trigger: Succession discussions, supervisor vacancies or an employee request for management development. The workflow below is inferred.
steps: Discuss future management needs with the HR Director, HR Business Partners and site leaders.
Gather role requirements, employee interests and manager observations.
Design a pathway combining courses, mentoring, stretch assignments and practical exercises.
Agree access, release time and assessment criteria with managers and relevant stakeholders.
Run the pathway and review progress through conversations and observed work.
systems: AFAS Profit for authorised role information
drudgery: Starting each pathway outline from scratch
Reformatting similar exercises and manager guides
Repeatedly adapting materials for different shifts and sites
today.time_sinks: Agreeing what readiness means and securing mentors, practice opportunities and release time. The stated baseline is 58.1 hours per FTE annually.

lenses.faster: AI turns approved role requirements and anonymised stakeholder notes into pathway drafts, exercises and mentor guides. L&D keeps responsibility for objectives, access and practical relevance.
lenses.autonomous: Approved cohort dates can trigger enrolment reminders and mentor check-ins. Programme design, participant selection and readiness judgments remain with people.
lenses.ambitious: Offer a visible route from warehouse operative to supervisor and onward to site management, alongside office routes. Test whether better supervisors improve new-hire proficiency and 90-day retention.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated drafting and document formatting. Keep coaching, discovering overlooked talent and designing worthwhile stretch assignments.
lenses.options: Compare a short supervisor pathway, a longer management pathway and an apprenticeship-style route. Show required release time, mentor capacity and practice opportunities for each.
lenses.altitude: Design the management development system and check whether access and outcomes are fair across sites, shifts and job groups. Improve the pathways using observed capability and employee feedback.
reach: HR Business Partner: prepare succession-development discussions
Recruiter: explain internal career routes to applicants
Site manager: develop supervisor coaching and onboarding practices

tasks.human_edge: Recognise potential through real work and trusted conversations, challenge narrow manager nominations and judge readiness in context.
tasks.pattern_why: AI can draft pathways and practice material, but executive potential, fair access and suitable stretch assignments require human judgment. Keep participant selection, coaching and promotion decisions human.

in_practice.trigger: An approved development brief specifying target roles, operational needs, available time and fair access criteria.
steps: Collect approved role standards, anonymised needs and employee feedback without medical or unnecessary personal information.
Ask an approved model to draft three pathways with observable learning objectives, exercises and mentor requirements.
Review the drafts with HR Business Partners and site leaders; test practicality across shifts and sites.
Complete required governance for changes to collective training arrangements, then publish the approved pathway in Studytube.
Run a cohort with human coaching and practical observation; revise using feedback and aggregate outcomes.
in_practice.human_gate: L&D approves content; HR and managers make participant and readiness decisions using published criteria. Obtain OR consent where the programme introduces or changes a collective training arrangement, subject to the applicable legal scope.
data_needed: Target-role responsibilities and observable capability standards
Employee-stated interests and human-confirmed development needs
Shift release time and mentor capacity
Approved access and assessment criteria
Existing course catalogue and practical assignment opportunities
Aggregate participation, progression and new-hire outcomes
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint programme record containing source documents, draft versions, reviewer decisions and governance approvals; approved learning records remain in Studytube.

evidence.claim: Studytube learning pathways can combine microlearning, online courses, internal events and external training.
Generative AI can plausibly draft management exercises and pathway alternatives from approved role standards; suitability needs human testing.
Collective personnel-training arrangements fall within the OR's consent topics, with scope assessed for the proposed change.
AI used for employment selection or promotion may be high-risk; keeping a human approval step does not itself settle classification.
The 30% effort saving and 1.35-times end-to-end speedup are estimates for design and administration, excluding any shortening of necessary learning practice.

risks: Manager nominations may favour office staff or day shifts unless access criteria and participation are reviewed.
Generic exercises may miss real logistics decisions involving staffing, safety and customer commitments.
Uploading named performance notes can create AVG/GDPR risks; use anonymised inputs for drafting wherever possible.
Extending the tool to score potential, select participants or recommend promotions requires a separate EU AI Act assessment; human approval alone is insufficient.
A development place can be mistaken for a promised promotion; explain the pathway and criteria clearly.
For employees returning under Wet verbetering poortwachter, coordinate adaptations with the HR Business Partner using agreed functional limits, without putting medical details into the model.
research_questions: Which observed capabilities distinguish successful supervisors and managers at each site?
Do shift workers have equal access to nomination, self-application, mentors and paid release time?
Do managers and employees rate AI-assisted exercises as more useful than the current materials in a pilot?
Does the intended tool only draft content, or will it influence individual access, assessment or promotion?

tasks.short: Create practical training on waste, energy and efficient working for our warehouse and transport teams.

today.trigger: A changed site procedure, environmental target or recurring operational problem needs training. The workflow below is inferred.
steps: Ask operations and the relevant safety or environmental owner what behaviour needs to change.
Collect approved procedures and examples from Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
Develop short lessons, demonstrations and checks suited to shifts and literacy levels.
Arrange supervisor briefings and publish approved materials in Studytube.
Gather feedback and review whether the targeted behaviour and site measures improve.
systems: Excel or Power BI for available operational measures
drudgery: Producing repeated site and language variants
Formatting quizzes and supervisor briefing sheets
Updating every version when a procedure changes
today.time_sinks: Confirming site-specific rules and checking that simplified instructions remain correct. The stated baseline is 26.8 hours per FTE annually.

lenses.faster: AI drafts short lessons, quizzes and supervisor prompts from approved procedures. Shared source references make it easier to find materials needing revision.
lenses.autonomous: A procedure change flags affected lessons and prepares replacement drafts. Reminders run after approval; technical instructions and revised content require review.
lenses.ambitious: Give each shift brief practice on its recurring waste or efficiency problems, including agreed provision for flex workers. Measure specific behaviours and waste per unit of activity.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive rewriting and formatting. Keep site visits, demonstrations and conversations that reveal why the correct practice is hard.
lenses.options: Compare a five-minute shift briefing, a visual job aid and a practical demonstration. Offer language and literacy variants for review by workers who will use them.
lenses.altitude: Own a process linking operational problems, current procedures, training and observed behaviour. Retire lessons that do not help and fix process barriers training cannot solve.
reach: Operations improvement lead: translate approved process changes into shift training
Safety or environmental owner: coordinate procedure communication
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: evaluate training participation against aggregate operational outcomes

tasks.human_edge: Watch the work, identify practical barriers and verify instructions with the people responsible for site safety and environmental procedures.
tasks.pattern_why: Source-grounded drafting can accelerate content creation, while operational accuracy and behaviour change need site expertise. Use deterministic version tracking and reminders around the human-led design process.

in_practice.trigger: An approved procedure change or a defined waste, energy or efficiency problem with an accountable operational owner.
steps: Collect current approved procedures, site differences and baseline measures; identify missing evidence.
Draft a short lesson, job aid and practical check with source references using an approved model.
Have the technical owner and representative shift workers check accuracy, clarity and language variants.
Publish approved versions in Studytube and SharePoint and arrange demonstrations where needed.
Review participation, observed behaviour and aggregate operational measures; revise or remove ineffective material.
in_practice.human_gate: L&D approves teaching quality; the relevant operational, safety or environmental owner approves technical instructions and translations. Practical certification and operational authorisation stay with authorised assessors.
systems: SharePoint approved procedures and version register
Proposed approved language-model service or Microsoft 365 Copilot, if licensed
Excel or Power BI using verified operational exports
data_needed: Versioned site procedures and named technical owners
Approved examples of correct and incorrect practice
Learner language, literacy and access needs without inferred nationality
Shift briefing windows and agency participation arrangements
Aggregate waste, energy or rework measures with activity denominators
Worker feedback and supervisor observations
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint content register containing source versions, generated drafts, technical and language approvals, publication dates and review results; enrolments and completions remain in Studytube.

evidence.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint can draft a presentation from a prompt or referenced file; licensing and review are still required.
AI can plausibly turn approved procedures into lesson and quiz drafts, but technical correctness and translation quality need review.
Connecting brief training to observed behaviours and normalised site measures could improve evaluation; no Noordhaven outcome has been demonstrated.
The 35% effort saving and 1.4-times end-to-end speedup are estimates; site review and practical demonstrations remain necessary.

risks: Generated instructions may confuse ordinary waste, hazardous materials or food-safety procedures; technical owners must verify each relevant lesson.
A translation error can change an instruction's meaning; validate variants with competent reviewers and users.
Completion of an online lesson does not establish forklift, VCA or other required practical competence.
Changes in volume, equipment or waste contractors can distort apparent training outcomes.
Individual behaviour monitoring would change the AVG/GDPR and OR assessment; prefer aggregate measures for this proposal.
New collective training arrangements may require OR consent; check scope before rollout.
research_questions: Which recurring behaviours cause measurable waste, energy use or rework at each site?
Are current procedures versioned and owned by someone who can approve training adaptations promptly?
Can shift workers and flex workers access the proposed formats and understand reviewed language variants?
Does a pilot improve observed behaviour or normalised operational measures compared with the current briefing approach?

role.altitude: Become the owner of the learning system that gets new starters productive, keeps required qualifications current and develops capable supervisors across three sites.
reach: Coordinate the training portion of week-one onboarding with HR Administrators and site supervisors.
Maintain training capacity and renewal forecasts with site planners and agency coordinators.
Prepare reconciled learning-spend scenarios for the Controller and FP&A team.
Develop transparent internal career pathways with HR Business Partners and Recruiters.
Translate approved operational changes into usable shift training.
Define learning and proficiency measures with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
role.ceiling_note: These four tasks cover about 13.7% of role time. The proposed savings total about 236 hours annually across 2 FTE, roughly 7.4% of their combined capacity or EUR 16,040 at EUR 68/hour, before implementation, review and maintenance costs. This is capacity value, not a demonstrated cash saving. End-to-end speedups are separate estimates because approvals and resource availability still create waiting time. Coaching, site observation, practical assessment and operational release time remain limiting factors.
skills_to_grow: Translate staffing, course and CAO requirements into testable scheduling rules.
Read integration logs and resolve failed or duplicate bookings with the HRIS Analyst.
Reconcile learning costs and distinguish actuals, commitments, accruals and forecast.
Design observable proficiency standards and practical assessments.
Review generated content, translations and source references.
Evaluate outcomes without confusing correlation with causation.
Design fair programme access and work with the OR on relevant changes.
Apply AVG/GDPR data minimisation and recognise when individual AI assessment needs EU AI Act review.
role.ambitious_version: Run a joined-up route from vacancy demand to productive work: forecast learning capacity, arrange week-one training, support supervisors with practical coaching and check proficiency through day 90. Include seasonal flex-worker provision under agreed agency responsibilities, maintain certificate renewals, and use aggregate cost, completion, proficiency and retention evidence to improve the routes. Keep individual selection, practical authorisation and sensitive employment judgments with accountable people.
